PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (9.0, 5.0, 16.0),      # diff pair gm/Id at integration
    "I_in":    (120e-6, 40e-6, 400e-6),  # per-side peak current at integration start
    "L_in":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),
    "Wn_lat":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),      # cross-coupled NMOS width
    "Wp_lat":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),      # cross-coupled PMOS width
    "W_rst":   (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),      # reset PMOS width
    "Wn_inv":  (0.8, 0.42, 4.0),      # output inverter NMOS width
    "tail_k":  (1.5, 0.8, 4.0),       # tail width / diff-pair width
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    Ls = 0.15

    # diff pair: vds moderate while P/Q discharge from VDD
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], p["I_in"], vds=0.6, vsb=0.1)
    W_in = max(0.42, m_in.W)
    W_tail = max(0.42, p["tail_k"] * W_in)
    Wn, Wp, Wr = p["Wn_lat"], p["Wp_lat"], p["W_rst"]
    Wni = p["Wn_inv"]; Wpi = 2.5 * Wni

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W_tail, Ls)
    # diff pair
    n.dev("M1", "P", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M2", "Q", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    # cross-coupled NMOS
    n.M("M3", "X", "Y", "P", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ls)
    n.M("M4", "Y", "X", "Q", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ls)
    # cross-coupled PMOS
    n.M("M5", "X", "Y", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Ls)
    n.M("M6", "Y", "X", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Ls)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "P", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, Ls)
    n.M("MR2", "Q", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, Ls)
    n.M("MR3", "X", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, Ls)
    n.M("MR4", "Y", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, Ls)
    # output inverters: X falls when vinp>vinn -> outp high
    n.M("MI1n", "outp", "X", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wni, Ls)
    n.M("MI1p", "outp", "X", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wpi, Ls)
    n.M("MI2n", "outn", "Y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wni, Ls)
    n.M("MI2p", "outn", "Y", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wpi, Ls)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cpu = 1.0e-15   # ~1 fF/um gate+junction per um width (L=0.15)
    C_P = m_in.cdd + (Wn + Wr) * cpu
    C_X = (Wn + Wp + Wr) * cpu + (Wn + Wp) * cpu + (Wni + Wpi) * cpu
    # integration: P/Q fall by ~Vthn so the latch NMOS turns on
    t_int = C_P * 0.65 / p["I_in"]
    Av = m_in.gm * 0.65 / p["I_in"] if p["I_in"] > 0 else 5
    Av = max(2.0, min(Av, 15.0))
    gm_lat = lut.size("n", 8, Ls, p["I_in"], vds=0.6).gm
    gm_lat = min(gm_lat, Wn * 30e-6 * 8)
    tau = C_X / max(gm_lat, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(VDD / 2 / (Av * dv))
    t_inv = 0.69 * cl * 3e3 / Wni + 10e-12
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv
    # energy: P,Q both recharge; X,Y one fully; one output toggles; clock gate load
    C_sw = 2 * C_P + 1.3 * C_X + cl + (W_tail + 4 * Wr) * cpu + 2 * (Wni + Wpi) * cpu
    energy = C_sw * VDD ** 2
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
